post_operation: check return value (compare against 0 / propagate error before using read data)
critical_variable: return value of regmap_bulk_read (int error code)
path_conditions: any path after calling regmap_bulk_read inside an IRQ handler / function returning irqreturn_t — must branch on error before using ts->conversion_data
rationale: regmap_bulk_read() returns int; non-zero means failure. The buggy ad7879_irq() ignores the return value and proceeds to use ts->conversion_data via ad7879_report(). Fix introduces 'int error = regmap_bulk_read(...); if (error) dev_err_ratelimited(...); else if (...) mod_timer(...);'. Classic missing-return-value-check (CWE-252).
